description: Permanently deletes a draft invoice. This action cannot be undone. Use when you need to remove a draft invoice. Finalized or subscription invoices must be voided instead.

inputSchema.description: Request model for deleting a draft invoice.

invoice.description: The identifier of the invoice to be deleted. Must start with 'in_' followed by alphanumeric characters. Only draft invoices can be deleted.
invoice.title: Invoice

inputSchema.title: DeleteInvoiceRequest

name: delete_invoice

DeleteInvoiceResponse.description: Response model for a deleted invoice.

deleted.description: Always true for a successful deletion.
deleted.title: Deleted

id.description: The identifier of the deleted invoice.
id.title: Id

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'invoice' for this endpoint.
object.title: Object
